subQuests.subQuestName: Follow Deakin

40120101.text: So... are you one of the guards here? Is there anything we should be careful of while we're here?

40120103.text: Uh... did Paimon already ask something she wasn't supposed to?

40120104.text: Why should I tell you anything? What's in it for me?

40120107.text: *sigh* This is exactly why I can't stand new fish. I wouldn't even be doing this if it weren't for the Credit Coupons.

40120109.text: Alright, seeing as you're not the annoying kind that's getting dragged in here crying and blubbering, I guess I can tell you a few things... But next time, it'll cost you some coupons.

40120110.text: Mora means nothing here. Here, we use Credit Coupons.

40120111.text: Coupons can get you almost anything in the Fortress of Meropide. Desires? Fulfilled. You want power? No problem. Coupons can even change fate itself.

40120112.text: So Credit Coupons are a currency that can only be used here?

40120113.text: It's not as simple as that. Like Marette said, everyone gets a chance at "rebirth."

40120114.text: No matter how much money or power you had before, it means nothing once you set foot inside the Fortress of Meropide. You have to start over and earn your coupons.

40120115.text: Everyone starts from the same place, and you have a chance at a new, less terrible life...

40120116.text: I guess that's the real purpose of the coupons. They symbolize true fairness and true justice!

40120117.text: And this is also exactly why so many criminals choose not to return to the outside world even after they've served their sentence.

40120118.text: Oh, so that's what the Fortress of Meropide is like... Paimon was under the impression that it'd be more like a prison...

40120119.text: It certainly ain't all sunshine and roses here, but it's also not the worst place to be... You'd better take a good look at the scenery now, it'll be the last chance you get for a while.

40120120.text: After being away from the sunlight for so long, even the terrifying depths of the sea start to feel like home... it just stops feeling oppressive, you know?

40120121.text: Oh, I'm actually an inmate like you two. Welcoming newcomers is a job I've picked up to earn some extra coupons.

subQuests.subQuestName: Ride the lift
Go to the corners of the corridors

40120329.text: It was okay. His attitude could use some work, though.

40120330.text: I see. In that case, I regret to announce that Deakin here has just missed the best opportunity in his prison career to be promoted.

40120331.text: I... uh, I admit that I was only thinking about the coupons... I'm sorry to have disappointed you, Your Grace. I originally... I once hoped for a chance to do some higher-level work.

40120332.text: *sigh* I had no idea you two were big shots who were worthy of speaking with His Grace... Losing out on such a big opportunity because I couldn't see past my own nose...

40120333.text: Plenty of time ahead, Deakin. There will be more opportunities.

40120338.text: Well, I believe that concludes the introductions. We've already taken enough time here. Deakin, if you would.

40120339.text: Yes! Your Grace, I'll take my leave now!

40120340.text: Please, follow me. To make you feel more welcome, I'll show you around the various facilities of the Fortress of Meropide. I hope it will help you adjust to life here.

40120341.text: He's going to personally give us a tour? Paimon can't figure out what this guy's thinking at all...

40120344.text: No wonder Charlotte's so interested in him! He's one of those mysterious types. Alright, let's keep up with him.

40120334.text: He's taken great care of us. Splendid chap, really.

40120335.text: Outstanding. Well, Deakin, I recall we discussed fate during our last work meeting. I believe that fate will reward all those who take every aspect of their work and life seriously.

40120336.text: When you return to your bunk, you'll find the guards have issued some extra Credit Coupons to you.

40120337.text: Oh, thank you... Thank you, Your Grace! Oh, and you two! I can't believe you gave me such praise. If you need anything in the future, anything, please come find me anytime! No Credit Coupons necessary!

subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to Wriothesley at the Coupon Cafeteria

40120401.text: There's no need to be so reserved. The label of criminal is nothing but one of many identities, and being criminally inclined here at the Fortress is just one of many ways to survive.

40120402.text: Is it really okay for the warden to think like that? We're real criminals, you know! What if we're too difficult to handle?

40120403.text: Well then, maybe you'll be able to carve out a name and a place for yourselves in this underwater world, hm?

40120404.text: But before you go in swinging, please remember that in the Fortress of Meropide, it's better to not cause trouble for yourself... or for the guards.

40120405.text: Now, we've arrived at a very important place: the Coupon Cafeteria. You can come here and claim one welfare meal each day.

40120406.text: Welfare meal? You mean... it doesn't cost anything?

40120407.text: That's right. Criminals are essential to fortress operations, so we must guarantee that they at least have the basic means to survive.

40120408.text: Haha, but that's not how it was! Back in the day, it'd cost you Credit Coupons just to get a cup of water here.

40120409.text: For fish like you who'd just arrived with nothing, you'd have to go to work hungry until you earned enough coupons to eat.

40120410.text: It was only after His Grace became the administrator that we got the free meal rule.

40120411.text: Now everyone gets a square meal every day, even no-good slackers who've never picked up a wrench in their whole lives. Nobody starves to death here.

40120412.text: In the Fortress of Meropide, Credit Coupons are the only currency, and everything must be purchased. In some sense, you could say using the coupons is a form of trade.

40120413.text: But trade is always conducted by people, so if we want trade here to prosper, we need everyone to work hard and live their lives.

40120414.text: If nobody could even afford a meal, then the whole fortress would be up in arms. That would only make things more difficult for me.

40120415.text: So rather than saying that we're giving everyone a free meal here, you should say that everyone's hard work has improved the living conditions in the Fortress of Meropide.

40120416.text: Your Grace's reasoning is correct, but what I said is also true.

40120417.text: Whatever the case, hard work is rewarded here. You'd be hard-pressed to find anywhere else as fair and reasonable.

40120418.text: Right, Paimon sees your point. By that logic, this place doesn't seem so bad after all.

40120419.text: Wait, no! We shouldn't drop our guard so quickly... But it seems the inmates really respect the Duke because of his attitude, right? Hmm, we should still try to verify the truth with our own eyes.

subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to Wriothesley at the Pankration Ring

40120501.text: This place is known as the "Pankration Ring."

40120502.text: Sometimes we have criminals who have more energy than they know what to do with... their daily work alone isn't enough of an outlet for them.

40120503.text: So, instead of leaving them to their own devices, we've provided them with this dedicated venue. This way, nobody will get involved unless they want to be.

40120504.text: #Pankration matches... And you can earn extra coupons! What do you think, {NICKNAME}? Interested?

40120505.text: But I must warn you that your sentence will be extended if you fail to restrain yourself and end up seriously injuring or killing your opponent.

40120508.text: So, did you set this place up too?

40120509.text: No, actually. I just granted approval for the organizer to use this area to build the ring, and I collect a portion of the proceeds in return.

40120510.text: Of course, the fees are also quite useful.

40120511.text: Oh... Do you mind if we ask what they're used for?

40120512.text: Sure. Ensuring personal safety, maintaining the arena, and resolving any conflicts that arise... Why? Are you interested in how to manage a Pankration Ring?

40120513.text: Oh, no no! Paimon was just wondering if that's how you paid for everyone's welfare meals...

40120514.text: A reasonable guess. I see you have a talent for entrepreneurship.

40120515.text: You hear that? Paimon has a talent! So, we can start a business here?

40120516.text: That is something you can discuss between yourselves later. Let's move on for now.

subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to Wriothesley at the dormitories

40120601.text: Ah, Y—Your Grace! Good morning... I mean, good afternoon! ...No wait, what time is it again?

40120602.text: What time indeed. Time waits for no one, so it's best to keep an eye on it.

40120604.text: Geez, that guy's so nervous he almost forgot to breathe...

40120606.text: These are the dormitories, which is where inmates sleep. The guards will inform you where your bunk is later.

40120607.text: In the Fortress of Meropide, criminals usually spend most of their time in either the production zone or the sleeping areas.

40120608.text: The production zone... what does it produce? Is that where we'll be working?

40120609.text: Not necessarily. Though working in the production zone is the most reliable way to earn Credit Coupons, if you have other skills, you can skip your shifts to earn them in other ways.

40120610.text: Wow... Wait, you're the manager of this place and you're just telling us to our faces that it's okay to skip work!?

40120611.text: The fact that the Fortress of Meropide has continued operating completely autonomously is proof enough that most people are willing to work honestly and earn a stable income.

40120612.text: As for what we produce... many of the clockwork machines seen all over Fontaine originate from our workshop.

40120613.text: Therefore, the Fortress of Meropide is not only a place where criminals serve their sentences, but also a giant machine factory.

40120614.text: There's no need for me to get into specifics about the production process now. You'll experience it all firsthand when you report for work tomorrow.

40120618.text: Let's move on. The tour continues over this way.

40120623.text: Oh! You really scared me there... I didn't expect to see you here, Your Grace. I thought maybe I was so tired from work that I was starting to see things.

40120624.text: The only thing you should be seeing is the work in front of you. Stay focused and keep up the pace.

40120626.text: Hehehe, it's nothing... Paimon's just worried about how hard we'll have to work tomorrow, hehe...

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the infirmary and talk to Wriothesley

40120701.text: Your Grace? What are you doing in the infirmary at a time like this? Oh no, you didn't injure yourself, did you?

40120702.text: Not yet, unfortunately for you. But thank you for your concern, Sigewinne.

40120703.text: Hehe, then you must be here for those two.

40120704.text: Allow me to introduce you. This is the infirmary, and Sigewinne here is the Fortress of Meropide's head nurse.

40120705.text: Hello, new faces! They call me the head nurse, but I actually handle all the nurse-related work all by myself down here!

40120706.text: Since you seem to have some rare downtime with no patients, perhaps you could find the time to join us for dinner?

40120707.text: Oooh, then these two must be some important convicts. Sure, I'll join the welcome party!

40120708.text: Thank you. Your presence will be the piece de resistance for today's tour.

40120709.text: Oh, so the tour part is over now?

40120710.text: I believe I've already covered the primary aspects of life here in the fortress. As for your work, there'll be someone else to guide you through the details. Hmm, is there anything else...?

40120711.text: I seldom conduct tours, so why don't you just ask if you have any questions?

40120712.text: Oh, uh, well... This is our first time here, Paimon's not sure what to ask...

40120713.text: Then let's head back to the Coupon Cafeteria. Maybe a meal will help you think up some questions.

40120714.text: You should at least try to be excited. Our free meals are actually pretty good here.

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the Coupon Cafeteria to get some food

40120801.text: What do you think of the food? Does it meet your expectations?

40120802.text: Wow, it looks delicious... Neuvillette made it sound like living conditions in the Fortress of Meropide weren't very good. Who woulda guessed that criminals get to eat tasty food like this every day!

40120805.text: Isn't that the meal box that only super lucky people manage to draw? Seems like you two are quite fortunate.

40120806.text: It actually has nothing to do with luck in this case. I had a word with Wolsey so you didn't have to draw lots like everyone else.

40120807.text: Oh, you mean the meals are random?

40120808.text: Yes, what you get to eat depends completely on your luck. You could say that it's a... distasteful little game that Chef Wolsey likes to play here in the cafeteria.

40120809.text: Paimon knew it! If criminals got to eat tasty food like this every meal, the crime rate in Fontaine would skyrocket for sure!

40120810.text: Excuse me, did I hear you mention Neuvillette just now? I've been wondering how he's doing. Is he busy with work? Has he been taking care of his health?

40120811.text: He seems healthy no matter how you look at him, but he works so hard all the time, so it must be really tiring...

40120812.text: Sounds like he hasn't changed a bit. Looks like you can stop worrying so much, Sigewinne.

40120813.text: That's good... but I still feel like it's been too long since I've heard any news about him.

40120815.text: Maybe the next time I've got something to discuss with him, I can invite you to accompany us.

40120816.text: Hmm? But isn't the Fortress of Meropide independent from Fontaine's court system? What do you two have to discuss?

40120817.text: Well, we provide all kinds of mechanical products for official use, and some essential goods have to be obtained from the overworld, so we naturally have to stay in touch about this and that.

40120818.text: Monsieur Neuvillette's character is unimpeachable. No matter the question, you can discuss it openly and freely with him. Talking with him feels quite effortless.

40120819.text: In light of that, I am quite willing to go out of my way to show respect and accommodate him.

40120820.text: In fact, right now I'm treating you two as guests invited by Monsieur Neuvillette, but unfortunately, I can only do so until the end of this meal.

40120821.text: After this, you two will just be inmates here.

subQuests.subQuestName: Return to the dormitories and talk to Fielding

40120901.text: #{NICKNAME} and Paimon, right? Listen up. As new inmates, the only thing you need to worry about is what to do and when to do it. Don't make any extra trouble for yourself.

40120902.text: Your bunks are right over there. Follow me.

40120903.text: Whew, so this is where we'll be sleeping from now on...? Paimon can't believe this! *sigh* The days of staying home and reading detective stories are like a dream now...

40120904.text: #By the way, {NICKNAME}, we saw a lot of things worth investigating just now...

40120905.text: Even though the Duke didn't say it too directly, judging from what he said at the end, it seems that he was only welcoming because we know Neuvillette...

40120906.text: We are criminals, and Paimon did eat that cake... But we're actually here to help Neuvillette.

40120907.text: Hmm... Is it possible that he knows we're here on a mission? Or is Paimon overthinking things?

40120910.text: Yeah, Paimon thinks so, too. He probably knew why we came here from the very beginning and intentionally wanted to send us a message...

40120911.text: Maybe something like, "Hey, I have my eyes on you, so don't try anything funny!"

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the production zone to talk to Grainville

40121001.text: Ah, you must be the catch of the day. Looks like you've got some luck, getting assigned this space...

40121002.text: Yep, we just arrived yesterday and...

40121003.text: Don't interrupt me when I'm speaking!

40121005.text: Listen carefully to my instructions. I don't want any mishaps. Every machine here is worth more than the both of you!

40121006.text: Working around these machines can be very dangerous. Do your job well, and you can eat in the cafeteria after your shift. Get sloppy, and you dine in the infirmary.

40121007.text: Anyway, the Fortress of Meropide doesn't want to lose a single one of its machines, and it also doesn't want to waste the production potential of any inmate. You got that?

40121009.text: Your job is to use the machine over there to process widgets.

40121010.text: Watch carefully and make sure you step on the pedal at the right time. If the machine gets jammed, then give it a little "maintenance" with your fist.

40121012.text: Bring me the processed widgets and I'll give you some Credit Coupons in exchange.

subQuests.subQuestName: Process widget
Take the widget

40122301.text: Are you finished eating? Then I recommend that you return to the dormitories and rest. You have work to do tomorrow.

40122302.text: Perhaps you were hoping to ask for some special privileges? Sorry, you'll have to use Credit Coupons like everyone else. It's not as comfy here as you might imagine.

subQuests.subQuestName: Give the products to Grainville

40121201.text: Hmm, this one is... tolerable... though since the processing is done by machine, the product is all pretty much the same anyway.

40121202.text: Alright, I'll pass you for now, and we'll count up how many Credit Coupons you've earned.

40121203.text: Whew, Paimon's exhausted! We're done now, right? Oh, that foreman! He's so scary that Paimon couldn't even speak...

40121204.text: Ugh... even though Paimon's starving and wants to head straight to the Coupon Cafeteria... we still need to meet Lyney first, right?

40121205.text: He probably just finished up his work too, he should be around here somewhere...

40122401.text: Now that I've gotten a good look at you two, I think you're very cute.

40122402.text: After all, heavy is the head that wears the cutesie crown. I guess I just want to say, just take care of yourself and don't get hurt.

subQuests.subQuestName: Keep looking for Lyney in the area
Keep looking for Lyney
Keep looking for Lyney

40121302.text: Wha—! You scared Paimon! How did you appear out of nowhere like that!?

40121303.text: Oh? You scare so easily now? Is there something worrying you these days?

40121304.text: You little... The only thing we were worried about was trying to find you!

40121305.text: Hehe, sorry, sorry! Come over here, and keep it down...

40121306.text: Oh, Lynette! You're here too! You two really are inseparable.

40121307.text: That's right, my brother simply can't stand to be away from me.

40121308.text: Uh, it's not just Lynette, Freminet is also here. Do you still remember him?

40121309.text: Oh, you mean that diver from the House of the Hearth, right? Paimon remembers seeing him in the Court of Fontaine before.

40121310.text: Now hurry up and tell us, how did you end up as criminals this time? We fought so hard at court to prove you were innocent, but now it looks like our incredible court battle was for nothing!

40121311.text: Sadly, even the tiniest of things can land you in prison these days, you know. I put together a street performance and used the popularity we gained from the opera house incident to attract a big crowd.

40121313.text: Next, I invited several audience members to participate in the show. And then, with the entire audience watching... their wallets suddenly disappeared!

40121314.text: My brother was charged with theft, and I was charged as his accomplice, having assisted him in his crime.

40121315.text: It isn't really that bad... The missing wallets are all in the leftmost drawer of the Maison Gardiennage's big filing cabinet. We just need to see how long it takes to discover them.

40121316.text: Yes, we should be released then.

40121317.text: In terms of the magic trick itself, I think the performance went perfectly.

40121318.text: ...Leave it to Lyney to magic himself into prison.

40121321.text: Indeed. Last time I hid my identity from you, I promised that I'd tell you absolutely everything if you were angry about it, no more secrets.

40121322.text: So I don't plan on keeping anything from you this time, either. At the moment, the House of the Hearth's interests don't conflict with yours at all.

40121323.text: We were instructed by the "Father" of our House, The Knave, to come here and conduct an investigation.

40121324.text: Told you so! See, Paimon guessed right.

40121325.text: As for what we're investigating... Perhaps you haven't heard, but the Fortress of Meropide hides a secret.

40121326.text: Some even say that the entire fortress exists just to protect it.

40121327.text: The House of the Hearth has been investigating this for a very long time, trying to uncover its mysteries...

40121328.text: But recently all of our informants, including the ones that had infiltrated the guards, suddenly vanished and have not been heard from since.

40121329.text: We believe that this is a direct provocation, and it's the reason why we came here.

40121330.text: Why is the House so interested about this secret?

40121331.text: "Father" has somehow managed to confirm that Focalors does not have Fontaine's Gnosis.

40121332.text: Huh!? How did she manage to learn information that important?

40121333.text: "Father" has her ways... Many of them are beyond our imagination, and we've never had the chance to see her at work. But we trust her conclusions.

40121334.text: It was this information that led us to suspect that Fontaine's Gnosis might be in the Fortress of Meropide, and is related to that "secret."

40121335.text: So it's all about the Gnosis again.

40121336.text: Well, that's about it from our side, how about you two? Did Monsieur Neuvillette send you here?

40121337.text: Bingo! The Knave has been applying a lot of pressure. She wants to know what happened to Childe, so we came here to investigate...

40121338.text: #...Ah! {NICKNAME}... Are we allowed to tell them?

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the Coupon Cafeteria to get some food

40121401.text: He wasn't kidding. Today's meal is nowhere near as good as last time. *sigh* Who knows how long it'll be until we're lucky enough to get that super tasty meal again...

40121404.text: Eh, forget about it then. We'll just deal with the regular food for the time being. Let's just get out of here as soon as possible.

40121405.text: But life here doesn't seem all that bad, other than the foreman being kinda mean and the work being pretty tiring...

40121406.text: You think so, mate? Ah, if I had a coupon for every fish who's said that...

40121407.text: Seems you fishies still haven't learned your lessons from your life up on the surface...

40121408.text: If you take things at face value, then by the time you reach a dead end, you won't even know how you ended up on that road in the first place.

40121409.text: Have some advice for us, old timer?

40121410.text: Heh, I like your attitude. I can let you in on a little something...

40121411.text: Everyone's been telling you to just follow the rules and not cause any trouble for yourself, am I right?

40121412.text: But what they don't tell you is that the rules aren't exactly what they pretend to be — the rules for being a prisoner.

40121413.text: The truth is, this place has a lot of "hidden rules"...

40121415.text: Not everyone knows about those rules, but whether you know 'em or not, once you break one... you might encounter something even worse than death.

40121416.text: R—Really...? Ooh, now you're really scaring poor Paimon, don't joke around like that...

40121417.text: Have some advice for us, old timer?

40121418.text: Of course, and I'd say that just disappearing would be one of the better outcomes.

40121419.text: Oh, you mean that if there really are "hidden rules," then Childe's disappearance might have something to do with that?

40121420.text: Uh, in that case... Would you tell us some hidden rules? We definitely want to avoid breaking them...

40121421.text: Hehe... C'mon mate, this is valuable information, the difference between life and death. D'you really think you can just ask and I would tell you?

40121422.text: Paimon understands... But we don't have many Credit Coupons yet...

40121423.text: Yeah, yeah, I know... Not like I'm going anywhere. Just come talk to me after you've saved enough.

40121424.text: Moreover, you're new fish, freshly caught, and completely out of your element... What'd be the point in even telling you anything before you've gotten a handle on your new lives? Come and find me once you've been here longer.

40121425.text: I'm usually around the Rag and Bone Shop. Just call me Vidoc. Bye bye now.

40121426.text: He left, just like that? Do you think he's just trying to scare us into buying fake information from him?

subQuests.subQuestName: Return to the dormitories to rest

40121501.text: So, Paimon just confirmed with the guards that our shift is set for every morning, and we're free to do whatever we want all afternoon...

40121502.text: ...But it seems like most of the other inmates choose to continue working through the afternoon to earn more Credit Coupons.

40121503.text: Oh, and they also said that you can use coupons to skip work in the morning and free up your time.

40121504.text: They weren't kidding... Credit Coupons really can be used to do anything here...

40121505.text: *yawn* Paimon's so tired... and we'll need to wake up and go to work in the morning. Without any Credit Coupons, it's not like we can really do anything else.

40121506.text: #Nighty night, {NICKNAME}. Paimon hopes we can keep making progress on our investigation tomorrow.

subQuests.subQuestName: Additional

40120301.text: So this is the actual entrance to the Fortress of Meropide.

40120302.text: It looks like there are other new arrivals, too. They sure don't look happy... Maybe we look too relaxed for fresh convicts?

40120305.text: Oh, right... we're on someone else's territory now. We need to think of a good way to act like criminals to get by...

40120306.text: If we're discovered, even Neuvillette might not be able to rescue us...

subQuests.subQuestName: Additional

40129901.text: So if the machine gets jammed, you just need to attack it to fix the problem!

40129902.text: Once the widget is hot enough to glow, jump to step on the pedal and hit the widget with the hammer!

40129904.text: Great, now we can report back to the foreman and give him the processed widgets!

40129905.text: Lyney! Mr. Magician! Where are you? This had better not be some disappearing act!

40129906.text: He doesn't seem to be around here. Let's try looking somewhere else.

40129907.text: Where could he be? Did he decide to slack off and sleep the day away?

40129908.text: So we're going even deeper now? Just how deep down are we?

40129909.text: It's like a metaphor for your previous life, isn't it?

40129910.text: Uh... our lives weren't that bad!
